releaseCommands.staging: gh workflow run deploy-staging.yml --repo dartflow/platform --ref main -f sha=<exact-tested-main-sha> -f config_id=staging-2026-11-18-play-safety-1
releaseCommands.production: gh workflow run deploy-production.yml --repo dartflow/platform --ref main -f sha=<same-tested-main-sha> -f config_id=production-2026-11-18-play-safety-1
releaseCommands.ocheSigningOnly: gh workflow run oche-android-ci.yml --repo dartflow/platform --ref main -f signed_bundle=true
releaseCommands.playerPlay: gh workflow run player-play-release.yml --repo dartflow/platform --ref main -f action=<check-access|upload-internal|promote-production> -f source_sha=<tested-main-sha> -f release_tag=<verified-release-tag> -f bundle_sha256=<exact-aab-sha256> -f version_code=<unused-increasing-code>

deploymentLimitations: The application deployment broker does not run database migrations; additive schema changes need the existing separate migration route and a verified backup.
Source-SHA CI and staging checks are required by the release gates.
No platform-wide acceptance or physical-device completion is claimed by this environment audit.
